paragraphs.text: And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the back, close sealed with seven seals.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐπὶ τὴν δεξιὰν τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου βιβλίον γεγραμμένον ἔσωθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν, κατεσφραγισμένον σφραγῖσιν ἑπτά.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon epi tēn dexian tou kathēmenou epi tou thronou biblion gegrammenon esōthen kai opisthen, katesphragismenon sphragisin hepta.

paragraphs.text: And I saw a strong angel proclaiming with a great voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to loose the seals thereof?
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον ἰσχυρὸν κηρύσσοντα ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ· Τίς ἄξιος ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ λῦσαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ;
paragraphs.translit: kai eidon angelon ischyron kēryssonta en phōnē megalē· Tis axios anoixai to biblion kai lysai tas sphragidas autou;

paragraphs.text: And no one in the heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look thereon.
paragraphs.original: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐδὲ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό.
paragraphs.translit: kai oudeis edynato en tō ouranō oude epi tēs gēs oude hypokatō tēs gēs anoixai to biblion oute blepein auto.

paragraphs.text: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look thereon:
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐγὼ ἔκλαιον πολὺ ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἄξιος εὑρέθη ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό·
paragraphs.translit: kai egō eklaion poly hoti oudeis axios heurethē anoixai to biblion oute blepein auto·

paragraphs.text: and one of the elders saith unto me, Weep not; behold, the Lion that is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, hath overcome to open the book and the seven seals thereof.
paragraphs.original: καὶ εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγει μοι· Μὴ κλαῖε· ἰδοὺ ἐνίκησεν ὁ λέων ὁ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα, ἡ ῥίζα Δαυίδ, ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: kai heis ek tōn presbyterōn legei moi· Mē klaie· idou enikēsen ho leōn ho ek tēs phylēs Iouda, hē rhiza Dauid, anoixai to biblion kai tas hepta sphragidas autou.

paragraphs.text: And I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent forth into all the earth.
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἶδον ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων ἀρνίον ἑστηκὸς ὡς ἐσφαγμένον, ἔχων κέρατα ἑπτὰ καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἑπτά, οἵ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ πνεύματα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἀπεσταλμένοι εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon en mesō tou thronou kai tōn tessarōn zōōn kai en mesō tōn presbyterōn arnion hestēkos hōs esphagmenon, echōn kerata hepta kai ophthalmous hepta, hoi eisin ta hepta pneumata tou theou, apestalmenoi eis pasan tēn gēn.

paragraphs.text: And he came, and he taketh [it] out of the right hand of him that sat on the throne.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ εἴληφεν ἐκ τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου.
paragraphs.translit: kai ēlthen kai eilēphen ek tēs dexias tou kathēmenou epi tou thronou.

paragraphs.text: And when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having each one a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ὅτε ἔλαβεν τὸ βιβλίον, τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα καὶ οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀρνίου, ἔχοντες ἕκαστος κιθάραν καὶ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας θυμιαμάτων, αἵ εἰσιν αἱ προσευχαὶ τῶν ἁγίων·
paragraphs.translit: kai hote elaben to biblion, ta tessara zōa kai hoi eikosi tessares presbyteroi epesan enōpion tou arniou, echontes hekastos kitharan kai phialas chrysas gemousas thymiamatōn, hai eisin hai proseuchai tōn hagiōn·

paragraphs.text: And they sing a new song, saying,     Worthy art thou to take the book, and to open the seals thereof: for thou was slain, and didst purchase unto God with thy blood [men] of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation,
paragraphs.original: καὶ ᾄδουσιν ᾠδὴν καινὴν λέγοντες· Ἄξιος εἶ λαβεῖν τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἀνοῖξαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσφάγης καὶ ἠγόρασας τῷ θεῷ ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς καὶ γλώσσης καὶ λαοῦ καὶ ἔθνους,
paragraphs.translit: kai adousin ōdēn kainēn legontes· Axios ei labein to biblion kai anoixai tas sphragidas autou, hoti esphagēs kai ēgorasas tō theō en tō haimati sou ek pasēs phylēs kai glōssēs kai laou kai ethnous,

paragraphs.text: and madest them [to be] unto our God a kingdom and priests; and they reign upon earth.
paragraphs.original: καὶ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν βασιλείαν καὶ ἱερεῖς, καὶ βασιλεύουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
paragraphs.translit: kai epoiēsas autous tō theō hēmōn basileian kai hiereis, kai basileuousin epi tēs gēs.

paragraphs.text: And I saw, and I heard a voice of many angels round about the throne and the living creatures and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
paragraphs.original: Καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἀγγέλων πολλῶν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν ζῴων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, καὶ ἦν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν μυριάδες μυριάδων καὶ χιλιάδες χιλιάδων,
paragraphs.translit: Kai eidon, kai ēkousa phōnēn angelōn pollōn kyklō tou thronou kai tōn zōōn kai tōn presbyterōn, kai ēn ho arithmos autōn myriades myriadōn kai chiliades chiliadōn,

paragraphs.text: saying with a great voice,     Worthy is the Lamb that hath been slain to receive the power, and riches, and wisdom, and might and honor, and glory, and blessing.
paragraphs.original: λέγοντες φωνῇ μεγάλῃ· Ἄξιόν ἐστιν τὸ ἀρνίον τὸ ἐσφαγμένον λαβεῖν τὴν δύναμιν καὶ πλοῦτον καὶ σοφίαν καὶ ἰσχὺν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν καὶ εὐλογίαν.
paragraphs.translit: legontes phōnē megalē· Axion estin to arnion to esphagmenon labein tēn dynamin kai plouton kai sophian kai ischyn kai timēn kai doxan kai eulogian.

paragraphs.text: And every created thing which is in the heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and on the sea, and all things are in them, heard I saying,     Unto him that sitteth on the throne, and unto the Lamb, [be] the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the dominion, for ever and ever.
paragraphs.original: καὶ πᾶν κτίσμα ὃ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης, καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς πάντα, ἤκουσα λέγοντας· Τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ καὶ τῷ ἀρνίῳ ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
paragraphs.translit: kai pan ktisma ho en tō ouranō kai epi tēs gēs kai hypokatō tēs gēs kai epi tēs thalassēs, kai ta en autois panta, ēkousa legontas· Tō kathēmenō epi tō thronō kai tō arniō hē eulogia kai hē timē kai hē doxa kai to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn.

paragraphs.text: And the four living creatures said, Amen. And the elders fell down and worshipped.
paragraphs.original: καὶ τὰ τέσσαρα ζῷα ἔλεγον· Ἀμήν. καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν καὶ προσεκύνησαν.
paragraphs.translit: kai ta tessara zōa elegon· Amēn. kai hoi presbyteroi epesan kai prosekynēsan.
